facts.fact_value: Public lead enrichment descriptions commonly frame enrichment as adding structured company context such as company size, funding stage, recent news, technology stack, and research hooks to a basic prospect identifier.
facts.evidence_snippet: Public page describes enrichment as adding contextual company and market data to a basic prospect identifier.

facts.fact_value: A public KnowledgeSDK article describes a web-data lead enrichment pipeline that extracts structured company attributes such as description, pricing signals, technology stack, hiring signals, and recent news before CRM use.
facts.source_title: Enrich CRM Leads with Real-Time Web Data Using AI | KnowledgeSDK Blog
facts.evidence_snippet: The article outlines extracting structured company intelligence from public web content for enrichment workflows.

facts.fact_value: A public CRM enrichment page describes using web sources to fill missing CRM fields and improve lead scoring, routing, and reporting with fresher company information.
facts.source_title: CRM Enrichment API - Enhance Lead Data Automatically | WebScraping.AI
facts.evidence_snippet: The page presents CRM enrichment as filling missing fields from web sources for scoring, routing, and reporting.

facts.fact_value: A public business development agent page describes account research outputs as grounded in research and structured so downstream tools or sales teams can inspect the evidence-backed brief.
facts.source_title: Business Development Agent - AI BDR for Account Research & Outreach | Strongly.AI
facts.evidence_snippet: The page emphasizes account research briefs grounded in facts and traceable research before use.

recommended_next_action: Use validated research evidence before enrichment/scoring; do not route to outreach.
